summary: Verified new customer confirmation email feature. Customer confirmation to booking email works (202 + 'Customer confirmation sent for booking <id>' log). Template is correct: escapes first name (<=40 chars), service, DD/MM/YYYY date, time; excludes notes; subject '... recebemos seu agendamento'; Reply-To from EMAIL_REPLY_TO; failures caught & logged. Frontend confirmation shows 'Enviamos um resumo para' + data-testid='booking-confirmation-email'. Rejected bookings (weekend) send no emails. However, INTERNAL notification to agendamento@castassessoria.com.br is now being REJECTED by the Emergent email proxy (Resend) with HTTP 422 'Undeliverable recipient' — a deliverability/account issue, not code regression. Code still handles it gracefully (booking succeeds, error logged). Created 2 TEST_ bookings via API test + 1 via UI (3 total since 2 pytest runs happened); all 3 cleaned up via admin DELETE.

critical.issue: Resend proxy returns 422 'Undeliverable recipient — Recipient looks undeliverable and was blocked before sending to protect deliverability. For testing, send to delivered@resend.dev' when target is agendamento@castassessoria.com.br. This blocks the internal office notification. Previous iteration_4 reported 202 for same recipient — likely the Resend account/domain verification lapsed or sandbox mode is active. Reproduced manually with direct curl to integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send using key from .env.

verifications.template_fixed_server_side: notify_customer_booking in /app/backend/email_service.py — only name/service/date/time escaped & interpolated; notes NOT included (unit test confirms SENSITIVE NOTES NOT in html)
verifications.first_name_escape_truncate: first = escape((booking['name'].split() or [''])[0][:40]) — only first word, max 40 chars, html-escaped
verifications.failure_safety: notify_customer_booking wraps send_email in try/except; forced RuntimeError test confirms no exception propagates
verifications.rejected_booking_no_email: Weekend 400 response produced zero 'Booking notification sent' or 'Customer confirmation sent' lines in subsequent log window
verifications.frontend_confirmation_text: 'Agendamento recebido, TEST_FrontendCust. Passaporte Brasileiro · 22/10/2026 às 09:00. Enviamos um resumo para delivered@resend.dev. Em breve entraremos em contato para confirmar.'

critical_code_review_comments: notify_customer_booking subject uses raw EMAIL_FROM_NAME (not escape()). Since EMAIL_FROM_NAME is a trusted env var ('Cast Assessoria'), this is OK, but subject-level escaping would be more defensive.

notify_new_booking should be adjusted to handle Resend sandbox mode (current 422) — consider: (a) verifying domain in Resend dashboard, (b) using a verified from-address, or (c) adding an admin-level alert when notify_new_booking fails > N times. The current try/except silently drops the office notification — client gets email, office doesn't.

In email_service.send_email, resp.raise_for_status() loses the Resend error body; consider logging resp.text on 4xx so operators see 'Undeliverable recipient' immediately in supervisor logs instead of a bare httpx error.
Minor: notify_customer_booking date_br assumes ISO; same as notify_new_booking (safe because upstream validates via date_cls.fromisoformat).
action_items: Resolve Resend/Emergent email proxy deliverability: investigate why agendamento@castassessoria.com.br is rejected with 'Undeliverable recipient' 422. Likely requires domain verification or lifting sandbox restriction on the EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY. Without this, the office never receives notifications even though code logs an error.
Enhance send_email to log Resend response body on 4xx (currently only generic httpx error shows up).

success_rate.backend: 75% (3/4 pytest; 1 fails only due to external Resend 422 on internal recipient)

seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ bookings during testing (2 via API test runs, 1 via UI). All 3 deleted via admin DELETE /api/admin/bookings/{id}. Customer confirmation emails went to delivered@resend.dev (Resend test address) — no real inbox impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer confirmation feature is implemented & verified end-to-end (code, logs, frontend). The only outstanding issue is EXTERNAL: the Emergent email proxy currently rejects the real client address agendamento@castassessoria.com.br with 422 Undeliverable. Reproduce by running test_customer_confirmation_email.py — test_create_booking_sends_both_emails will fail on the internal notification assertion. If retesting after a Resend/env fix, re-run only that single test (sends 1 email to delivered@resend.dev — no real-user email impact).
rca_of_the_issue: Direct curl against https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send with the current EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY and to=['agendamento@castassessoria.com.br'] returns: {"error":"Undeliverable recipient","message":"Recipient looks undeliverable and was blocked before sending to protect deliverability. For testing, send to delivered@resend.dev","code":"undeliverable_recipient"}. This indicates the Resend account behind the Emergent proxy is in sandbox / unverified-domain mode and only accepts delivered@resend.dev as recipient. Customer email works because the test used delivered@resend.dev. Mitigation: either (1) verify castassessoria.com.br domain / promote the Resend account out of sandbox, or (2) temporarily point BOOKING_NOTIFY_EMAIL to a verified recipient until domain is validated.
